questions.question: When a hook payload has no session_id, what should capture.mjs write for it?

options.label: Write null (Recommended)
options.description: Keep session_id: null, so every parsed line has the same keys (current behavior).

options.label: Leave field out
options.description: Write session_id only when the payload has one.

options.label: Write "unknown"
options.description: Use the string "unknown" as a placeholder instead of null.
